food.description: Food includes groceries, restaurants and eating outside.
food.guidance: Track restaurant and eating-out expenses separately and set a monthly food budget.

travel.description: Travel includes fuel, public transport, taxis and other transportation.
travel.guidance: Separate essential travel from optional travel and review unnecessary trips.

shopping.description: Shopping includes clothing, electronics and other purchases.
shopping.guidance: Before non-essential purchases, consider whether the purchase is necessary.

entertainment.description: Entertainment includes movies, games, subscriptions and recreational activities.
entertainment.guidance: Set a monthly entertainment limit and review recurring subscriptions.

bills.description: Bills include regular household and service payments.
bills.guidance: Track recurring bills and identify subscriptions or services that are no longer needed.
